page.overview:
Who is Abomenaticus?

Abomenaticus is a Decepticon Scramble City-type combiner composed by Transformers from various subgroups.

There isn't any official release of Abomenaticus, but it can be created from the toys of Terrorcons, Stunticons, and Combaticons.
